note: Every value here is a STARTING POINT for Katy to tune on the machine (xTool M1 Ultra), not a recommendation. Picked in Export, a material applies only invert, mirror and dpi; arriving with ?material= applies everything, algorithm and tone included.

materials.label: Wood
materials.why: Jarvis–Judice–Ninke keeps soft gradients smooth on grain; a slight gamma lift opens the mids, which burn darker on wood.

page.title: Dither a photo for laser engraving on wood
page.description: Turn a photo into a laser-ready dithered PNG for wood, sized in millimetres with the DPI written into the file. Free, and your image never leaves your device.

materials.label: Slate
materials.why: A laser turns slate lighter, not darker, so the image is inverted; extra contrast keeps the marks readable.

page.title: Dither a photo for laser engraving on slate
page.description: Slate engraves light, so the image is inverted for you. Get a dithered PNG at the exact size for LightBurn or xTool Creative Space, made in your browser.

materials.label: Acrylic
materials.why: Engraved from the back, the image is seen through the sheet, so it's mirrored; the frosted marks read as white, so it's inverted.

page.title: Dither a photo for back-engraved acrylic
page.description: Mirrored and inverted for engraving the back of clear acrylic. Download a dithered PNG at the exact millimetre size, made in your browser.

materials.label: Glass
materials.why: Fine, dense dots tend to chip glass, so a lower DPI and a coarser ordered pattern.

page.title: Dither a photo for laser engraving on glass
page.description: A coarser pattern at a lower DPI, because fine dots chip glass. Download a laser-ready PNG at the exact size, made in your browser.

materials.label: Leather
materials.why: Leather burns through in the shadows; a gamma lift compresses the dark range so they hold detail.

page.title: Dither a photo for laser engraving on leather
page.description: Shadows compressed so they don't burn through. Get a dithered PNG at the exact millimetre size for your laser, made in your browser.
